mapper.select: SELECT p.post_id, p.category, p.title, p.views, p.created_at, p.is_anonymous AS anonymous, CASE WHEN p.is_anonymous = 1 THEN '익명' ELSE u.user_name END AS author_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments c WHERE c.post_id = p.post_id) AS comment_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_likes pl WHERE pl.post_id = p.post_id) AS likes FROM posts p JOIN users u ON p.user_id = u.user_id WHERE p.category = #{category} AND p.post_id != #{postId} ORDER BY p.created_at DESC LIMIT 3

SELECT p.post_id, p.user_id, p.category, p.title, p.content, p.views, p.created_at, p.updated_at, p.is_anonymous AS anonymous, CASE WHEN p.is_anonymous = 1 THEN '익명' ELSE u.user_name END AS author_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments c WHERE c.post_id = p.post_id) AS comment_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_likes pl WHERE pl.post_id = p.post_id) AS likes FROM posts p JOIN users u ON p.user_id = u.user_id WHERE p.post_id = #{postId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO posts (user_id, category, title, content, is_anonymous) VALUES (#{userId}, #{category}, #{title}, #{content}, #{anonymous})
mapper.update: UPDATE posts SET views = views + 1 WHERE post_id = #{postId}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO post_likes (user_id, post_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{postId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM post_likes WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND post_id = #{postId}
mapper.select: SELECT post_id FROM post_likes WHERE user_id = #{userId}
